testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-user-association.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23087 sales rep of the single store is assigned to a single-store user

scenario.summary: For a user of store A only, Manage User offers only store A in Store Name, the Sales Rep popup lists only store A's sales reps, and the selected store A sales rep is saved for the user.
steps: Accounts & Users > Users; open the user (@user.userName) of store A with Manage.
Click the search icon next to Sales Rep.
Select the sales rep of store A (@rep.fullName).
Click Save and Close; re-open the user.
stateChanges: The user's sales rep is set to the store A sales rep (both deleted at teardown).
assertions: Only store A is in the Store Name dropdown
Only store A's sales reps are listed in the popup (the store B sales rep is not)
The selected sales rep is saved for the user with store A
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 9 (group B remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 9.3.
FSD 'Store Assignment Rules for Sales Rep': a sales rep is available for user assignment only in its stores.
Manage User requires first and last name and the created user has none: the test fills names it makes up (created-by-test) before Save and Close, as 23085.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A). Store B: STORE_WEBSTORE_ACTIVE with exceptPortalId = @storeA.portalId (any other active webstore).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
